description: Persistent storage of the valkey nodes.

enabled.description: Whether the nodes have a volume.

size.description: Size of the volume of every node. Defaults to `global.fallbackDefaults.vctSize`.

storageClass.description: Storage class of the volumes. Defaults to `global.fallbackDefaults.storageClass`.

retain.description: Whether the volumes are retained when a node is deleted. Defaults to `global.fallbackDefaults.pvcRetain`.
